title_sq: Apartament 2+1+2 ne shitje ne rrugen Asim Vokshi, tek Kompleksi Panorama ne Tirane (ID 41212138)
description_sq:

title_en: Apartment 2+1+2 for sale on Asim Vokshi Street, in the Panorama Complex in Tirana (ID 41212138)
description_en: On Rruga Asim Vokshi, in the Panorama Complex, Apartment 2+1+2 in the new building (built in 2021), furnished in all luxurious ways, is for sale. Surface area 150 m², 5th floor with elevator, air conditioner, dishwasher. It is organized in a living room, two bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, 2 balconies, sunny orientation. The price is 360,000 euros.
